name: Press, Mixer and Basin
description: Create machines do not work through menus.

pages.title: Press, Mixer and Basin
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Machines act on items **in front of them**, not through menus.
- **Press**: ingots into sheets. Over a basin it compacts.
- **Mixer** over a **Basin**: shapeless recipes and alloys like brass.
- A basin pushes results out only when it has an output block.

Create machines do not work through menus. They act on **items sitting in front of them**: items on a belt, on a depot, or inside a basin. Most of them need [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() to run.\
\
Hover a machine and hold W for its [#](2E5AAC)[Ponder](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

pages.title: Mechanical Press
pages.text: Hits whatever is under it. On a belt or depot it presses ingots into sheets. Over a basin it [#](7A3C9A)[compacts](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() the contents.
The press hits items on the depot below it: ingots become sheets.

Pressing a plain item makes a **sheet**: iron, gold, copper and brass sheets are building blocks for later machines.\
\
Over a **Basin**, the press compacts: any filled 2x2 or 3x3 crafting recipe, plus some extras (some need heat, see [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]()).

pages.title: Mechanical Mixer
pages.text: Sits above a basin and stirs. Handles any shapeless crafting recipe, plus extra recipes like alloying.

pages.title: Basin
pages.text: Holds items and fluids for the mixer or press above it. Has no output until you give it one.

[#](2E5AAC)[Brass](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]() is the classic mixer job: copper and zinc ingots in a basin, with a [#](2E5AAC)[heated](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() burner under it. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for the exact [#](7A3C9A)[mix](entry://glossary/mixing)[#]().\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** if two recipes fit the same contents, put an item in the machine's [#](7A3C9A)[filter slot](entry://glossary/filter_slot)[#]() to pick one.

**Basin output**: the basin shows a faucet and pushes finished items into the spot **one block down, beside it**. A depot, belt or chute there takes them, or a funnel facing up on a chest, placed while sneaking so it inserts. The block beside the basin itself must stay open.

A chest or barrel in that spot gets nothing. Put it one block lower with a funnel on top, so the funnel sits in the spot. With no output the basin keeps results inside, useful when they are ingredients for the next step.\
\
If you pull from a basin, use a [#](2E5AAC)[filter](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]() so unprocessed items stay.
